captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a simple, parametric drinking cup or beaker. It features a tapered, conical body that is wider at the top rim than at the flat base. The walls have a uniform, solid thickness, creating a clean hollow interior with a smooth transition from the bottom to the top.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric drinking cup (beaker) in OpenSCAD with adjustable top diameter, bottom diameter, total height, and wall thickness. Use a robust rotational extrusion method to define the outer and inner profiles of the cup.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a `difference()` operation between two rotated shapes. First, an outer profile polygon is defined using the bottom radius, top radius, wall thickness, and height, then extruded with `rotate_extrude(segments=180)`. Second, an inner cavity polygon is defined to represent the hollow interior, which is also extruded using `rotate_extrude()` and subtracted from the outer shape.
